results.name: Caterpillar Work Boot
results.description:
** Caterpillar Second Shift Steel Toe Work Boot **

*Quality oiled full grain leather, T3 Rubber Slip-Resistant Outsole, Steel Toe with up to 600 volt open circuit protection.*

*32.2 x 12.6 x 20.7 cm (133 micrometers per texel @ 4k)*

Scanned using advanced technology developed by inciprocal Inc. that enables highly photo-realistic reproduction of real-world products in virtual environments. Our hardware and software technology combines advanced photometry, structured light, photogrammtery and light fields to capture and generate accurate material representations from tens of thousands of images targeting real-time and offline path-traced PBR compatible renderers.

Zip file includes low-poly OBJ mesh (in meters) with a set of 4k PBR textures compressed with *lossless* JPEG (no chroma sub-sampling).

results.name: Frostbone Keep
results.description:
Wanted to make use of the long rendering time for commissioned work, so I decided to upload my recent castle build.

Minecraft 1.11 Map Download:

http://www.mediafire.com/file/l22h2a50ptt8yi9

*****

This build project was originally just a gradient palette test using the quartz, bone, mushroom stem, and diorite block. Then I decided to make a castle using that palette, with the angular roof style similar to the Minas Morgul of the LotR series. I've added animated gates with soundeffects using command blocks, and custom monsters that spawns randomly in the castle.

Unfortunately had to change the design before uploading because Mineways doesn't export armorstands, shulker boxes, and custom textured player heads.

*****

Built in Minecraft ver 1.11 using default texture. Map clean up with WorldEdit and MCEdit. Exported with Mineways (still getting misplaced blocks). Unwrapped uv in ZBrush. AO, light, and gradient map (for fake fog) baked in 3ds Max. Beacon light beam and snow particles added in 3ds Max.

results.name: Model 66A - Atlantic Sturgeon
results.description:
This is an animation of an subadult Atlantic Sturgeon.

This 3D model is a composite of images from a subadult Atlantic Sturgeon  (Acipenser oxyrhynchus oxyrhynchus) housed at the Maymont Nature Center (https://maymont.org/animals/nature-center/), and a scan from a preserved Atlantic Sturgeon from the Natural History Collection at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst (https://bcrc.bio.umass.edu/nhc/home).

CG artists Jer Bot, Johnson Martin and Robert Gutierrez used Blender to reconstruct the full fish from these scans and images, as well as animate the movements. Thanks to the Maymont Nature Center, the Richard Lewis Media Group (http://rlmg.com/), and the Natural History Collection for facilitating the work.

Downloads are freely available for creative and non-profit use. To inquire about licensing, please visit **www.digitallife3d.org**.
